title: 电流表：串联才能测电流
summary: 先把电流表接错一次，看它把 LED 短路；再断开电路，把表接进断口。

rail.title: 认识电流表：一个很小的电阻
text: 电流表就是万用表拨到 mA 档。两支表笔：电流从**红表笔**流进去，从黑表笔流出来。
![](inside:ammeter#1)

rail.title: 先点亮一颗 LED
text: 一个 9 V 电池、一个 `1 kΩ`、一颗红色 LED，接成一个圈。

rail.title: 故意接错：把电流表并在 LED 两端
text: 像量电压那样，把电流表的两支表笔点在 **LED 两端**。看 LED，再看**诊断**。
![](steps:here)
![](measure:par)
![](inside:ammeter#6)

rail.title: 电压表并联，电流表串联
text: - **电压**是两点之间的：万用表并联在两点上，自己几乎不取电流。
- **电流**是流过一条路的：要知道多少水流过一根管子，就得把管子**切开**，让水全部从表里流过。电流表要**串联**进电路。
![](fig:series)
- 电流表的内阻很小，这里只有 **0.1 Ω**，几乎就是一根导线。把它并联在 LED 两端，电流全从它身上抄近路走了——LED 被**短路**，所以灭了。
![](fig:parallel)
- 读数是“**从红表笔流进去**的电流”。红黑接反，读数变成负数——电流没变，变的是参考方向。

rail.title: 断开，再把表接进断口
text: 把错的表拿掉，在 + 轨和电路之间**切一个口**，让电流表来补上这个口。

rail.title: 读电流，再量电流表两端的电压
text: 读数要在完整的电路上读：先点一次「检查我的电路」，读数框就会打开。
![](measure:i)
![](measure:uam)
![](derive:rb)
![](measure:rb)

rail.title: 红黑对调：读数怎么变
text: ![](steps:here)
![](measure:swap)

rail.title: 带走
text: - **量电流三步：断开 → 串进去 → 红进黑出。**
- 电流表并联在电源两端，真实的表会**烧保险丝**，严重时烧表。这里只会把元件短路，并给出诊断。
- 真实万用表 mA 档的内阻是几欧到十几欧（说明书里叫“负担电压”），在低电压电路里会让电流明显变小；10 A 档内阻小，但读不准小电流。
从现在起，你能“看见”电压和电流了。接下来用它们去拆解串联和并联。

rb.title: 电流表自己的电阻怎么算
steps: 电流表也是一个元件：它两端有一点电压 $V_{AM}$，流过它的就是你刚读到的电流 $I$。
单位小心：mV ÷ mA = Ω。用你自己的两个读数代进去。

description: 电流表要串进电路：先断开，再把表接进断口，让电流从红表笔流进、从黑表笔流出。它的内阻只有 0.1 Ω，并联在元件两端就等于用导线把元件短路。电路：9 V 电池 → 电流表 → R1（1 kΩ）→ 红色 LED → GND。

caption.text: ✓ 电流表串进电路：电流全部从红表笔流进去、黑表笔流出来。

i18n.en: ✓ The ammeter in series: all of the current goes in at the red probe and out at the black one.

caption.text: ✗ 电流表并在 LED 两端：它几乎就是一根导线，电流全从它身上抄近路，LED 被短路熄灭。

i18n.en: ✗ The ammeter across the LED: it is almost a wire, the current takes the shortcut through it and the LED goes out (shorted).

en.title: The ammeter: in series, always
en.summary: First connect the ammeter wrong and watch it short the LED; then break the circuit and put the meter into the gap.
en.description: An ammeter goes in series: break the circuit, put the meter into the gap, and let the current flow in at the red probe and out at the black one. Its resistance is only 0.1 Ω, so across a part it shorts the part out like a wire. Circuit: 9 V battery → ammeter → R1 (1 kΩ) → red LED → GND.
steps: **Jumper** **`tp5`** → **`a5`**. The current enters the circuit from the + rail through it — this is where the ammeter will go.
**Jumper** **`a13`** → **`tn13`** back to GND. The LED lights.
**Wrong on purpose**: pick **Ammeter**, red probe on **`b10`**, black probe on **`b13`** — the ammeter is **across** the LED. What happened to the LED? Check the Diagnostics.
Delete this ammeter: click it and press **Delete**.
**Cut a gap**: delete the jumper **`tp5`** → **`a5`**. The LED goes out — the current has no path.
**Put the ammeter in the gap**: red probe on **`tp5`** (where the current comes from), black probe on **`a5`**. The LED lights again and the meter shows the current through the whole loop.
Swap it: delete the ammeter and place it again with the red probe on **`a5`** and the black probe on **`tp5`**. How does the reading change? And the LED?
Back again: red probe on **`tp5`**, black probe on **`a5`**.
hints: An ammeter goes into the circuit: break it where you want to measure, then let the current flow in at the red probe and out at the black one.
Negative reading? Red and black are swapped. The current did not change direction; your reference did.

measurements.ask: With the ammeter across the LED, what does the LED do?
choices: it goes dark: the current takes the shortcut through the meter
it gets brighter: there is one more path
measurements.explain: The ammeter's resistance is only 0.1 Ω, practically a wire. Across the LED, all the current goes through it and the LED is shorted out.

measurements.ask: Predict with the LED's drop of about 1.8 V, then read: ammeter AM1's reading (red probe on the + rail side)
Multimeter: red probe on the + rail next to the ammeter's red probe, black probe (Shift) on column 5: the voltage across the ammeter
measurements.explain: 0.1 Ω × 7.1 mA ≈ 0.71 mV — ten thousand times smaller than the other voltages in the circuit.

measurements.ask: Work out the ammeter's resistance from your two readings: R = voltage across the ammeter / current
measurements.explain: 0.1 Ω: practically a wire, which is why it must go in series.

measurements.ask: When you swap the ammeter's red and black probes, the reading:
choices: Keeps its size but turns negative
Drops to 0 and the LED goes out
measurements.explain: The current is the same and the LED stays lit; the reading is the current flowing in at the red probe, so the reversed direction shows as a minus sign.

rail.title: Meet the ammeter: a very small resistor
text: An ammeter is a multimeter switched to its mA range. Two probes: the current flows **in at the red probe** and out at the black one.
![](inside:ammeter#1)

rail.title: Light an LED first
text: A 9 V battery, a `1 kΩ` resistor and a red LED in one loop.

rail.title: Wrong on purpose: the ammeter across the LED
text: Touch the ammeter's two probes **across the LED**, the way you would measure a voltage. Look at the LED, then at the **diagnostics**.
![](steps:here)
![](measure:par)
![](inside:ammeter#6)

rail.title: Voltmeter across, ammeter in series
text: - **Voltage** is between two points: the multimeter sits across the two points and takes almost no current.
- **Current** flows along a path: to know how much water goes through a pipe you have to **cut the pipe** and send all of it through the meter. An ammeter goes **in series**.
![](fig:series)
- An ammeter has a tiny resistance, here just **0.1 Ω** — practically a wire. Across the LED, all the current takes the shortcut through the meter: the LED is **shorted out**, so it goes dark.
![](fig:parallel)
- The reading is the current **flowing in at the red probe**. Swap red and black and it turns negative — same current, opposite reference direction.

rail.title: Break the circuit, put the meter in the gap
text: Remove the wrong meter, **cut a gap** between the + rail and the circuit, and let the ammeter close it.

rail.title: Read the current, then the voltage across the meter
text: Readings are taken on the whole circuit: press **Check my circuit** once and the reading boxes open.
![](measure:i)
![](measure:uam)
![](derive:rb)
![](measure:rb)

rail.title: Swap red and black: what does the reading do?
text: ![](steps:here)
![](measure:swap)

rail.title: Take away
text: - **Measuring current in three steps: break → put it in → red in, black out.**
- A real ammeter across a supply **blows its fuse**, or worse. Here it only shorts the part out and the diagnostics tell you.

- A real multimeter's mA range has a few ohms to a dozen ohms of resistance (the "burden voltage" in its manual) and can noticeably reduce the current in low-voltage circuits; the 10 A range has less resistance but reads small currents poorly.
From now on you can "see" voltage and current. Next you use them to take series and parallel circuits apart.

rb.title: Working out the ammeter's own resistance
steps: The ammeter is a part too: there is a small voltage $V_{AM}$ across it, and the current through it is the $I$ you just read.
Mind the units: mV ÷ mA = Ω. Put in your own two readings.

tests.name: 电流表串在电路里，LED 亮

compare:
**对比**：I = (9 V − 1.8 V) / (1 kΩ + LED 内阻 12 Ω) ≈ **7.1 mA**。
- 电流表两端的电压 = 0.1 Ω × 7.1 mA ≈ **0.71 mV**，所以它几乎不改变电路；
- 表笔接反时读数 ≈ −7.1 mA；
- 并联在 LED 两端时，LED 被短路熄灭，电流表读到的是 9 V / 1 kΩ ≈ 9 mA——这不是 LED 的电流，而是“被短路以后”的电流。

measurements.ask: 电流表并在 LED 两端时，LED 怎样？
choices: 灭了：电流从电流表抄近路走了
measurements.explain: 电流表的内阻只有 0.1 Ω，几乎是一根导线。并在 LED 两端，电流全走它，LED 被短路。

measurements.ask: 先用 LED 压降约 1.8 V 预测，再读：电流表 AM1 的读数（红表笔在 + 轨一侧）
万用表：红表笔点 + 轨上电流表红表笔那一侧，黑表笔（Shift）点第 5 列：电流表两端的电压
measurements.explain: 0.1 Ω × 7.1 mA ≈ 0.71 mV——比电路里其他电压小一万倍。

measurements.ask: 用你的两个读数算电流表的内阻：R = 电流表两端电压 / 电流
measurements.explain: 0.1 Ω：几乎是一根导线，所以它必须串联。

measurements.ask: 把电流表的红黑表笔对调时，读数怎么变？
measurements.explain: 电流没变，LED 照样亮；读数是“从红表笔流进去的电流”，方向反了就是负数。

steps.text: **跳线** **`tp5`** → **`a5`**。电流从 + 轨经过它进入电路——待会儿电流表就接在这里。
**故意接错**：选**「电流表」**，红表笔单击 **`b10`**，黑表笔单击 **`b13`**——电流表**并联**在 LED 两端。LED 怎么了？看看「诊断」。
删掉这块电流表：单击它，按 **Delete**。
**切一个口**：删掉 **`tp5`** → **`a5`** 那根跳线。LED 灭了——电流没路可走。
**把电流表接进断口**：红表笔 **`tp5`**（电流从这边来），黑表笔 **`a5`**。LED 又亮了，表上显示流过整个回路的电流。
对调试试：删掉电流表重新放，红表笔 **`a5`**、黑表笔 **`tp5`**。读数怎么变？LED 呢？
再换回来：红表笔 **`tp5`**、黑表笔 **`a5`**。

hints: 电流表要串进电路：先断开要测的地方，再让电流从红表笔流进、黑表笔流出。
读数是负的？红黑表笔接反了。电流方向没变，只是参考方向反了。
